title: Even icosahedral Artin representations of conductors 1951 and 2141: Hecke eigenvalue tables, candidate Maass forms, and numerical tests of automorphy (replication kit)
description:
Replication kit for the even icosahedral Artin representations of prime conductors 1951 and 2141 (Doud and Moore, J. Number Theory 118 (2006) 62–70). Contents: exact Hecke eigenvalue tables a_p = tr ρ(Frob_p) for p < 10^5 for the conductor-N lifts of determinant χ (order 5), with Frobenius class, χ(p) and a provenance tag per entry; the candidate Maass cusp forms of eigenvalue 1/4 built from them; scripts and expected outputs for pointwise automorphy tests on complete generating sets of Γ_0(1951) (326 non-trivial generators) and Γ_0(2141) (358), for the Fricke involution, and for the adjoint L-functions L(s, Ad ρ) (functional equation at 2^-53; L(1, Ad ρ) to 30 digits; Rankin–Selberg constants); and a Heilbronn-type bound with an exact certificate: a pole of L(s, ρ) of order m at s_0 ≠ 1 forces ord ζ ≥ 4m over the degree-120 field and over the degree-600 field, and ≥ 8m for real s_0.

Claimed and not claimed. The README is the deposit statement, graded in three tiers: unconditional (the tables as exact objects, the bound with its certificate, the analytic data of L(s, Ad ρ)); conditional on the Artin conjecture for ρ (the candidate is the Maass newform); numerical evidence at finite precision and finitely many points (automorphy, Fricke, adjoint functional equation). The Artin conjecture for these representations is not claimed; entirety of the L-functions is not claimed; automorphy is tested, not proved. Searches on 2026-07-27, 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-12 found no prior numerical treatment of even icosahedral Maass forms or of these L-functions; the statement says what was searched and where the gaps are.

Provenance. The computations were produced between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-12 by Claude models (Anthropic) at the direction of the author, within a broader research program of his (TEP); nothing in the kit depends on that program, and its full working archive, with pre-registrations, sealed commitments, verification passes and errata, is deposited separately (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22727504). No result has been re-run by anyone outside the collaboration that produced it. On 2026-09-13 every script except the 34-digit pass was re-run from this layout and reproduced the deposited outputs exactly.

Licensing. Documents and data tables CC BY 4.0; code MIT.

Version 0.1.0 is released with the statement marked as a draft, offered and not yet countersigned; version 1.0.0 carries the countersigned statement.
